purpose: 对 remaining 12 道 not-promoted new-recipe-candidate 的现有 blocker 做只读机械分类与最低风险解锁方式分析。本轮不实施任何 remediation、不 promotion、不新增 alias/unit conversion/schema，仅基于已冻结的 canonical/readiness/runtime 数据给出结构化建议。

dispositionDefinitions.mechanical-fix-candidate: 仅需现有已验证机械规则（如 same-for-each 拆分）放宽 hard gate 即可解锁，无 source 重新解读、无信息损失、无需 alias/schema 变更。
dispositionDefinitions.targeted-review-required: 需要人工确认（如 alias/canonicalization 决策），有明确、有限范围的 review 任务。
dispositionDefinitions.schema-or-policy-required: 现有 production schema（{item, qty, unit} 单值）无法无损表达该语义（近似量、双数量），需先做 schema 或 policy 决策。
dispositionDefinitions.keep-blocked: 暂无已识别的安全解锁路径，维持 blocked。

minimalRemediation: targeted-review-required: decide whether "鸡血" should be (a) added as its own new canonical/family entry (safest, no cross-contamination risk) or (b) mapped into an existing family/probe (needs explicit human confirmation the semantics match); either path is an alias/canonicalization change and is out of scope for this triage round.

items.name: 炝黄瓜

inventoryIngredients.conversionReason: approximate-count：不伪造精确数值，保留原文“十余粒”作为 displayQuantity。

same-for-each：组“白糖、酱油”每项 15g，安全拆分继承。

semanticRisk: same-for-each split is lossless: "葱节、姜各三钱" becomes 葱节=15g and 姜=15g, exactly what the book states.
Converting "十余粒" (approximate) to any single number would misstate the source; current schema also cannot store the approximate text alongside null qty without a field addition.
minimalRemediation: same-for-each alone would not unblock this entry; it is also blocked by: non-exact-quantity.

policy-decision: either (a) accept qty=null/unit=null for approximate-count items (loses the "十余粒" text but is honest, not fabricated) and promote with only the exact-comparable ingredients carrying real numbers, or (b) extend the curated ingredient schema with a display-only quantity field before promoting so "十余粒" is not silently dropped. Neither is a mechanical converter change.
